name: chronulus
description: Teaches your agent to use the Chronulus MCP server (https://mcp.chronulus.com/mcp): binary outcome and multi-outcome prediction with BinaryPredictor and time-series forecasts with the NormalizedForecaster.

interface.shortDescription: Calibrated predictions and time-series forecasts from Chronulus AI
interface.longDescription: Best practices for the Chronulus MCP server: calibrated probability estimates for binary and multi-outcome questions with BinaryPredictor, and time-series forecasts with the NormalizedForecaster.
defaultPrompt: Use Chronulus to estimate the probability that a prediction market question resolves Yes.
Use Chronulus to forecast weekly demand for the next 12 weeks.
